messages:
Maya: heads-up — incoming customer ask from Cardinal Health: they want 'hephaestus-8b' on our Private stack, quantized for edge (target: q5-ish), latency budget ~120ms p95. can we triage feasibility?
Omar: tagging infra/quant folks. do we have a tokenization fingerprint for hephaestus yet?
Jin: not on file. I can run a tokenizer diff and a small perf pass later today. likely vocab close to gpt2 but confirm.
Sasha: infra note — on-prem package needs to fit within a single 80GB GPU ideally; if we can't, we'll need a multi-GPU plan and that's heavier for the customer.
Evelyn: customer also asked for deterministic outputs and on-device KV cache persistence. that increases complexity.
Maya: good catch. prioritize: 1) tokenization/compat, 2) quant pipeline attempt (q4/q5/q7), 3) perf smoke on 80GB A100, 4) eval regression on our standard conversational suite.
Omar: I'll grab a 1k prompt sample from the customer (they said dev dataset available) and run initial quality checks once Jin has tokenizer.
Jin: starting tokenizer diff now. quick note: hephaestus uses BPE with a 50k vocab. if merging with our conversion path, we might need a small mapping step.
quant-lab-bot: queued job #8791 for tokenizer-diff (input: hephaestus-vocab.json). ETA ~18m.
Sasha: infra ask: on-prem install currently supports single-node inferencing with up to 2 model partitions. if quantized to 4-bit, fits single node usually. need bench.
Maya: Jin, can you try a 4-bit symmetric quant first (q4_0) and a q5 mixed config? label them Q4SYM and Q5MIX. record perplexity and a few convo samples.
Jin: yep. will run Q4SYM and Q5MIX on a 1-step eval: 1000 tokens, batch=1 to mimic latency.
Evelyn: also please capture any hallucination/regression flags on our rouge/semantic tests. Cardinal cares about medical accuracy.
Omar: add a safety filter pass and point-eval for named-entity accuracy.
Maya: ETA for all initial artifacts (tokenizer diff, quant artifacts, perf numbers, eval report)? need to give customer a timeline.
Jin: tokenizer + first quant smoke by EOD PST. detailed eval + perf by tomorrow EOD.
Sasha: I'll reserve an 80GB A100 node for a 3-hour bench window tomorrow morning. pls post exact docker/stack config.
Maya: sample model conversion command (for the record):
```
python convert_model.py --src hephaestus-8b --out /tmp/hef8b-llm --vocab-map hephaestus_vocab.json --quant q4sym
```
Maya: add to checklist: conversion cmd, quant config file, perf script, eval prompt set, safety eval.
Omar: quick blocker: license for hephaestus artifacts — legal confirmed we have access for evaluation but not redistribution. note for Private packaging.
Evelyn: also confirm KMS/HSM flow for keys if the customer wants model encryption at rest.
ml-infra-bot: deploy-reservation created: node-a100-80gb reserved 2024-11-13T09:00:00Z to 12:00:00Z (owner: Sasha).
Jin: tokenizer diff complete — minor merges required for 12 tokens, I'll include mapping in artifact. starting Q4SYM now.
Sasha: reminder: if we need to fallback to multi-node, ops lead needs 48h notice for customer scheduling.
Maya: thanks team. I'll reply to Cardinal with a short timeline: tokenizer+smoke today, bench+eval tomorrow, a clear note on licensing and encryption. will link this thread. @Evelyn can you draft the license/encryption blurb?
Evelyn: on it, will post copy in this thread in 30m.
Omar: leaving a check: once Jin posts quant samples, I'll run quick manual spot-checks for clinical hallucinations and escalate if needed.
Jin: Q4SYM smoke results: latency p50 78ms, p95 160ms on 80GB A100 (batch=1, 512 prompt). quality diff: small drop on factuality in person-name recall tests — details in artifacts. uploading to /artifacts/hephaestus-2419004321/ now.
Maya: thanks. p95 160ms is above target; Q5MIX next to see if tradeoffs help.
quant-lab-bot: job #8792 completed: q4sym-smoke. artifacts: tokenizer-diff.txt, q4sym-metrics.json, samples_30.txt.
Jin: Q5MIX started. will tune per-layer quant config to aim for p95 < 140ms.
Evelyn: draft license/encryption blurb: "We confirm evaluation access under internal NDA; conversion artifacts remain Redwood internal; production deployment requires Cardinal to accept our Private deployment license and KMS integration for key management." posting full text in 10m.
Sasha: FYI ops: if Q5MIX still p95>120, we can propose a small latency SLO for customer or offer dedicated reserved capacity to hit target.
Maya: kept notes on rollout options. we'll reconvene after Q5MIX results. thanks all — thread link in customer reply. :thumbsup:
